hints.title: Sort to Discover Rank
hints.text: Sorting a copy of the array places each number immediately after all numbers strictly smaller than it.

hints.title: First Index Is Smaller Count
hints.text: In sorted array s, the first index where value x appears is exactly the number of elements strictly smaller than x.

hints.title: Map and Map Back
hints.text: Build a lookup table mapping each unique number to its first appearance index in sorted order. Then map nums.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every pair naively takes quadratic time O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the elements identifies smaller counts in O(N log N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate records the first index of each number in the sorted copy to handle duplicates.
complexity.notes: Can also use frequency bucket array of size 101 since nums[i] <= 100.
